command_line:
set +e
exec > probe.txt 2>&1
python3 --version
python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --target "$PWD/.deps" --no-deps miniwdl==1.12.0 importlib-metadata==4.8.3 regex==2023.8.8 xdg==5.1.1 docker==5.0.3 argcomplete==3.1.2 pygtail==0.14.0 coloredlogs==15.0.1 python-json-logger==2.0.7 lark==1.1.9 bullet==2.2.0 psutil==5.8.0 PyYAML==5.4.1
echo install_rc=$?
export PATH="$PWD/.deps/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps"
which miniwdl || true
python3 -c 'import miniwdl; print(miniwdl.__version__)' 2>&1 || true
miniwdl --version 2>&1 || true
miniwdl run --help 2>&1 | head -160
exit 0
